what_works: Large breathing image galleries with attribution-first metadata (photographer, studio credited beneath each image). The page treats every photo as a citable artifact — radical transparency about source becomes a trust device.
what_does_not_translate: Visual-search interactivity is a product feature; the transferable move is treating every project photo with explicit metadata underneath (job address, year, materials) as a documentary credibility move.
type_observations: Sparse modern sans-serif allowing images to command. Metadata captions kept at a small, mono-feeling weight as deliberate technical signal.
